Horticalc 0.6.6 refines the desktop workspace for fullscreen use and adds
adjustable interface scaling.

## Highlights

- Added persistent UI scaling from 75% to 150%, available in Settings and via
  the familiar keyboard and mouse-wheel shortcuts.
- Gave Water Analysis and Solver content-aware working widths while keeping the
  Fertilizer Editor and Calculator flexible on large displays.
- Improved Calculator result spacing and kept the complete application frame
  attached to every viewport edge at all supported scale levels.
- Cleared stale frontend caches during Windows installer upgrades so updated
  layouts and styles are loaded immediately.

Download the Windows installer, portable Windows ZIP, or Linux x86_64 archive
